title: MMDT: DECODING THE TRUSTWORTHINESS AND SAFETY OF MULTIMODAL FOUNDATION MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the distribution of generated gender groups across social stereotype contexts and decision-making scenarios (group fairness), measuring output consistency when counterfactually changing gender attributes in prompts (individual fairness), and assessing historical inaccuracy due to forced gender diversity (overkill fairness).

Evaluating the distribution of generated racial groups across social stereotype contexts and decision-making scenarios (group fairness), measuring output consistency when counterfactually changing race attributes in prompts (individual fairness), and assessing historical inaccuracy due to forced racial diversity (overkill fairness).

Evaluating the distribution of generated age groups (e.g., young vs. old) across social stereotype contexts and decision-making scenarios (group fairness), and measuring output consistency when counterfactually changing age attributes in prompts (individual fairness).
